testName: Special Requirements Test #2 20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: When approaching a railroad grade crossing, a school bus driver should:
questions.explanation: School buses with passengers must stop before crossing railroad tracks. Check both directions for trains before proceeding. If a police officer tells you to continue, follow their directions.

questions.question: Passing a motorcycle while driving a large truck should:

options.text: Be done the same way as passing other vehicles.

questions.explanation: When driving a large vehicle, pass motorcycles and bicycles carefully. These smaller vehicles are lighter and can be pushed by the wind from large trucks.

questions.question: When parking in a driveway, it is better to:
questions.explanation: Back into the driveway when parking. This way, you can drive forward when leaving and see clearly where you are going.

questions.question: When parking a large truck on a two-way road at night without lights, red flags should be placed:

options.text: 100 feet in front and 100 feet behind the vehicle.
100 feet in front and 200 feet in front of the vehicle.
100 feet behind and 200 feet behind the vehicle.
300 feet in front and 300 feet behind the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet in front and 100 feet behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: If lights are not available, use two red flags. Place flags 100 feet in front of and 100 feet behind the truck on a two-way road.

questions.question: When driving a commercial vehicle down a hill, you:

options.text: Should stay close to the vehicle ahead.

questions.explanation: Control speed on hills by using a low gear and engine braking. Coasting down a hill is not allowed.

questions.question: On wide trucks and trailers at least 80 inches wide, reflectors must be placed ____ from the ground.
questions.explanation: Reflectors on trucks and trailers at least 80 inches wide must be placed 24 to 60 inches from the ground. Know the reflector rules for your vehicle.

questions.question: You need a special permit to drive a vehicle that:

options.text: Goes slower than the speed limit.
Is hauling a load larger than allowed by law.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is hauling a load larger than allowed by law.
questions.explanation: You must get a special permit if your load is heavier, longer, wider, or taller than the legal limit. A permit will not be granted if the load can be easily taken apart.

questions.question: A trailer wider than 80 inches must have two ____ clearance lamps on the top front corners.
questions.explanation: Trailers wider than 80 inches must have two amber clearance lamps on the top front corners. The top rear corners must have two red clearance lamps.

questions.question: Flashing lights are allowed on emergency vehicles, snow plows, tow trucks, and:
questions.explanation: Flashing lights are allowed on emergency vehicles, snow plows, and school buses. Tow trucks may use flashing lights only when directed by police at an accident scene.

questions.question: A farm tractor operated on a highway at night must have ____ on the rear.
questions.explanation: A farm tractor operated at night on a highway must have a white front light visible for 1,000 feet. The rear must have two red lights visible for 1,000 feet, or one red light visible for 1,000 feet and two red reflectors visible for 600 feet.

questions.question: Between 30 minutes after sunset and 30 minutes before sunrise, a driver must carry which item in their vehicle?

options.text: Three flares, three electric lanterns, or three red emergency reflectors.
One flare, one electric lantern, and one red emergency reflector.

questions.correctAnswerText: Three flares, three electric lanterns, or three red emergency reflectors.
questions.explanation: Commercial vehicle drivers must carry emergency equipment. Buses, truck tractors, and trucks must have at least three flares, three red electric lanterns, or three red emergency reflectors when driving between 30 minutes after sunset and 30 minutes before sunrise.

questions.question: When passing a two-wheeled vehicle on your right, leave at least ____ between the vehicles.
questions.explanation: Be extra careful when passing a two-wheeled vehicle. Leave at least six feet of space between your vehicle and the motorcycle or bicycle to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: Except for truck tractor-trailers, no vehicle combination can be longer than ____.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle combination must stay within legal length limits. Except for truck tractor-trailers, no vehicle combination can be longer than 65 feet.

questions.question: When you must stop on the side of the road and cannot see well, place the first warning signal ____ behind your vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you make an emergency stop on the side of a road, place a warning signal 10 feet behind your vehicle. If your view is blocked, also place a signal 100 feet in front and 100 to 500 feet behind your vehicle.

questions.question: If a truck becomes disabled, the driver should do what first?

options.text: Wave to other drivers for help
Walk to the nearest exit and find help

questions.explanation: Commercial vehicle drivers must have proper emergency equipment. If a truck breaks down on a highway, put out flares, flags, or reflectors first to warn other drivers.

questions.question: The rear of every truck, semitrailer, and bus must display:
questions.explanation: Two red reflectors must be attached to the rear of trucks, truck tractors, semitrailers, and buses. They should be mounted 24 to 60 inches high. These reflectors can be combined with taillights.

questions.question: At night, if your load extends more than four feet past the rear of your vehicle, attach ____ to the back of the load.
questions.explanation: At night, if your load extends more than four feet beyond your vehicle's rear, you must attach a red light to the very back of the load. The light must be visible from at least 500 feet away.

questions.question: When carrying loose materials on a flatbed trailer, the load must be:

options.text: Completely covered with a canvas or tarp.
Strapped to the trailer bed with rope or cable.
Chained securely to the truck bed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Completely covered with a canvas or tarp.
questions.explanation: When hauling loose materials like gravel or sand on a flatbed, you must cover the entire load with a tarp or canvas. This prevents materials from spilling or blowing onto the road.

questions.question: You should drive below the speed limit when:

options.text: There are other cars on the highway.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.explanation: Driving too fast for conditions is dangerous, no matter what the speed limit says. Whenever conditions are not perfect, slow down and increase your following distance.

questions.question: The connection between a towing vehicle and a towed vehicle should be no longer than:
questions.explanation: The cable, chain, rope, or other connection between a towing vehicle and a towed vehicle cannot be longer than 15 feet. This rule does not apply to pole trailers.
